entry.title: New: Bill 91 (2024) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, APPENDIX C, CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECTS, OFFICE OF THE COUNTY CLERK, WAILUKU-KAHULUI COMMUNITY PLAN AREA" The purpose of this bill is to amend the Fiscal Year 2024 Budget, Appendix C, Capital Improvement Projects, Office of the County Clerk, Wailuku-Kahului Community Plan Area, Clerk’s Office Renovations to clearly state the renovations that will take place.
